'''Michael Fitzgerald''' (also published as '''Mike Fitzgerald''') is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/decks99k.htm No Shelter], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228072350/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/decks99k.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]], qualifying through Dagobah Tampa from Jupiter, Florida, United States.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
